Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: WHEELABRATOR CLAREMONT CO.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 5 gallons
ON 10/28/2010 EE WAS CLEANING CONVEYOR SCREW TO PREPARE FOR MAINTENANCE AND NOTICED THAT A 2 INCH GAP IN METAL RAIL ON FLOOR ALLOWED APPROXIMATELY 5 GALLONS OF FLYASH/LIME/WATER TO LEAVE THE BUILDING THROUGH THE DOOR AND DEPOSIT ON THE PAVEMENT IMMEDIATELY OUTSIDE OF THE ASH BAY BUILDING. EE IMMEDIATELY RESPONDED TO SPILL W/ SPEEDY DRY, CONTAINERIZED THE MATERIAL, LABELED CONTAINERS AND PLACED MATERIAL IN STORAGE. SAMPLE SENT TO LAB AND MATERIAL CAME BACK WITH CADMIUM LEVEL OF 1.2 PPM. REPORTED TO NHDES @ ~1:00 PM TUESDAY 14 DEC. 2010. INCIDENT BEING REPORTED EVEN THOUGH IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT REPORTING IS REQUIRED DUE TO RECEIPT OF LAB RESULTS TODAY.
